ai_summary: Aeroflex Enterprises Limited's 41st Annual General Meeting approved all proposed resolutions, including the adoption of the FY2025-26 audited financial statements and the declaration of a final dividend, with auditors reporting no qualifications or adverse remarks. Key material impacts involve the approval for an alteration of the company's Memorandum of Association's Object Clause and an increase in the limits for inter-corporate loans and investments under Section 186 of the Companies Act, 2013, which are significant strategic shifts warranting further scrutiny.
